# Clearance Deal Kenya

> Nairobi-based online retailer of wigs, hair bundles, extensions and beauty products serving Kenya. The catalogue includes human hair and synthetic products; consult each listing for material, price, stock and care details.

## Official information
- [Catalogue](https://clearance.co.ke/shop/): current product listings and prices in Kenyan shillings.
- [Contact](https://clearance.co.ke/contact-us/): Nairobi address and support contacts.
- [About](https://clearance.co.ke/about-us/)
- [Returns](https://clearance.co.ke/refund-policy/): eligibility, conditions and return shipping.
- [Terms](https://clearance.co.ke/terms-and-conditions/)
